issuer: Oregon Driver & Motor Vehicle Services (DMV, Oregon Department of Transportation)
note: Oregon DMV's driver information page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class C licence, for a person at least 18 (a provisional licence below), at $64.00 for an eight-year original issuance ($30 more for REAL ID), and the non-driver identification card, no minimum age, at $47.00 for an eight-year original issuance.

sources.title: Oregon DMV, Driver Information
sources.said: A Class C non-commercial license allows a person who is at least 18 years old to drive ... Eight-year original license issuance $64.00 ... Non-driver Identification Cards No minimum age limit. Fees: Eight-year original issuance $47.00
